Unauthenticated.description: unauthenticated — missing, malformed, unknown, revoked or expired token.

Forbidden.description: forbidden — the token’s user lacks the permission or a platform seat; org_mismatch when the {organisation} slug is not the token’s organisation (the same answer whether that slug exists or not, so it never means the resource is gone); mfa_required when the organisation requires MFA and the token’s owner has not enrolled (enrol in routeur.ai and the token works again); feature_unavailable when the plan lacks a feature.

NotFound.description: not_found — unknown workspace or id in the token’s organisation (including an ill-formed public id). An organisation slug that is not the token’s is a 403 org_mismatch, never a 404.

RateLimited.description: rate_limited — per token, 600 reads (GET) and 120 writes per minute, counted separately; plus 1200 requests/minute per IP before authentication. Wait for Retry-After seconds.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a retry can succeed.

ServerError.description: server_error — nothing about the cause is exposed; retry later.
